name: The Gilded Concord's Pressure on the Rulers

game.core.world.secret.summary: The Gilded Concord has privately presented its argument against Book of Truth education to all seven rulers. They are listening, but no named ruler has openly allied with the Concord.
game.core.world.secret.provenance: Approved as a Slice S5 merchant-coalition proposal during the world-creation interview (2026-08-22).
